title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We've officially launched Spyglass, bringing you powerful new capabilities to elevate your experience.

title: Total File Control in Your Editor
summary: Experience complete command over your embedded files with a redesigned management area, allowing you to effortlessly upload, remove, download, and tailor their appearance within your content.

title: Introducing the Noeko Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a brand-new public roadmap to provide full transparency into our recent accomplishments, upcoming features, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Experience a smoother workflow with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to interact with, and perfectly aligned with our sleek interface.

title: Seamless Collaborative Editing
summary: Experience smoother teamwork with enhanced real-time collaboration, clearly showing who is editing and how your work syncs effortlessly.

title: Seamless Collaboration & Content Sharing
summary: Effortlessly discover and utilize content shared by your connections, as shared items now seamlessly appear in your search results and integrated views.

title: Noeko Goes Global!
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out support for a diverse range of international languages.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, inviting our vibrant community to collaborate and shape its future with maximum control and transparency.

title: Interactive Constellation View
summary: Uncover deeper connections and streamline your workflows with an interactive Constellation View, empowering you to dynamically filter your knowledge by tags, time, and shared content.

title: Smart Search & Personalized Knowledge Collections
summary: Effortlessly narrow down your knowledge base with powerful new filters, flexible sorting options, and the ability to save custom search results as personalized collections for instant access.

title: Dynamic Note Previews
summary: Experience richer, interactive previews for your linked content, empowering you to structure your notes more intuitively and bring your ideas to life.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosting and Premium Features
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko your way with the upcoming launch of self-hosting capabilities and versatile premium plans designed to empower individuals and enterprises.

title: Stunning New Themes and Refined Classics
summary: We're launching a collection of vibrant new themes and significantly improving our existing ones to give you more personalized and visually appealing options.

title: Personalized Time-Sensitive Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized welcome every time you visit, as we update our homepage greetings to accurately reflect the current time of day in your location.

title: Streamlined Tag & Content Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your content by directly unapplying tags, deleting items, or viewing details right from any tag overview, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Bring All Your Content Together
summary: Easily integrate and interact with a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, to centralize all your essential information.
